scene_description: Four children are running together on green grass in a sunny park. One girl in the middle is holding a large orange and brown kite up in the air. The other children — a boy in white, a girl in red, and a girl in a striped dress — are running alongside her. There are trees and bushes in the background.

questions.question: What is the girl holding up in the air?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what the girl in the middle has in her hand above her head.

questions.question: What are all the children doing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the children's legs and feet — what are their bodies doing?

questions.question: Where are the children playing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the ground and the trees around the children.

questions.question: What do you do with a kite?
sample_answers: make it go up in the air
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what the girl is doing with the kite — is it going up or down?

questions.question: What might happen next if the girl keeps running with the kite?
sample_answers: the kite will go in the sky
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the kite — it is already up in the air. What happens when you run fast with a kite?

optional_extension_questions.question: Have you ever flown a kite or run outside with friends?
optional_extension_questions.evidence_hint: Think about a time you played outside.
